title: Independent brackish aquifer below the Osiris Shaft

tellings.quote: So, there's a very independent aquifer located directly below the Osiris shaft that is not connected to the Nile River.

plain: Right below the Osiris Shaft, a deep shaft cut into the rock of the Giza Plateau near the pyramids, there is said to be a body of underground water, an aquifer, that is "not connected to the Nile River." The researcher Jeffrey Drum tells Michels this without naming a source, while arguing that an energy system lies beneath the pyramids. A separate water source like that would fit his idea that the site was built for a special purpose.
